rule: An engine is shared by phenomenon. A node needs the engines of its lineage and of its scripts.

engines.does: Undo sound change at word and morpheme boundaries to recover the joined units.
engines.note: A working instance exists in the Classical Sanskrit node (vowel junctions). Extraction waits for a second language to need it.

engines.does: Analyse fusional inflection against stem and ending paradigms.
Extract consonantal roots and match vocalic and affixal templates.
Peel ordered affix chains, applying harmony where the language has it.
Resolve logograms, heterograms and determinatives to readings.
Map syllabic signs to values and keep every reading of a polyphonous sign.
Restore vowels the script leaves unwritten, returning every admissible reading.
Resolve inherent vowels, conjuncts and vowel signs, through the Romenagri script tables.
Find word boundaries in text the script does not divide into words.
Tokenise and count signs of an undeciphered or proto-writing corpus without assigning a language.
